_comment: Merge the 'blog-agent' entry below into the 'mcpServers' object of your own claude_desktop_config.json (macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json, Windows: %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json).
